examples.japanese: {勝敗|しょうはい}は{最後|さいご}まで{分|わ}からなかった。
examples.english: The outcome was uncertain until the end.

examples.japanese: {勝敗|しょうはい}が{決|き}まった。
{勝敗|しょうはい}にこだわらず{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.english: I enjoy it without worrying about winning or losing.

notes:
{勝敗|しょうはい} refers to the outcome of a competition - winning or losing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝敗|しょうはい}が{決|き}まる (outcome is decided)
- {勝敗|しょうはい}がつく (result is determined)
- {勝敗|しょうはい}を{争|あらそ}う (to compete for victory)
- {勝敗|しょうはい}を{分|わ}ける (to decide the outcome)
- {勝敗|しょうはい}にこだわる (to be concerned about winning/losing)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- スポーツ (sports)
- {試合|しあい} (games/matches)
- {勝負|しょうぶ} (contests)
- ビジネス (business)

COMPONENTS:
- {勝|しょう} = victory, winning
- {敗|はい} = defeat, losing

RELATED:
- {勝負|しょうぶ} (match, contest)
- {勝利|しょうり} (victory)
- {敗北|はいぼく} (defeat)

definitions.gloss: victory or defeat, win or loss, outcome
